mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.source_listing_id AS sourceListingId, p.building_id AS buildingId, b.sigungu_cd AS sigunguCd, p.title, p.property_type AS propertyType, p.trade_type AS tradeType, p.deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, p.maintenance_fee AS maintenanceFee, p.area_m2 AS areaM2, p.floor_info AS floorInfo, p.room_number AS roomNumber, p.address, p.room_num AS roomNum, p.bathroom_num AS bathroomNum, p.park_availability AS parkAvailability, p.transaction_status AS transactionStatus, p.property_description AS propertyDescription, p.available_date AS availableDate, p.move_in_date AS moveInDate, p.update_date AS updateDate, p.discussion_status AS discussionStatus, p.dong FROM property p JOIN building b ON b.id = p.building_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT recommend_score AS recommendScore, workplace_distance_meters AS workplaceDistanceMeters FROM property_value_analysis_result WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT image_url FROM property_image WHERE property_id = #{id} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT infra_category AS category, count_within2000m AS count FROM infrastructure WHERE building_id = #{buildingId} AND count_within2000m > 0
